name: Besalco S.A.
summary: Besalco S.A. operates as a construction company in Chile. It constructs reservoirs, tunnels, tailings dams, bridges, viaducts, gas pipelines, irrigation works, hydroelectric power plants, sanitation works, mining works, hospitals, stadiums, residential and commercial buildings, airports, and seaports, as well as works for the Santiago Metro and State Railways; assembles and develops projects for the expansion or modification of existing facilities; and engineers and constructs complex industrial plants, as well as designs and constructs electrical power transmission systems.
